assertions.subject: Congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: A notable Italian study conducted in 2011 by Fesslova et al examined the recurrence of congenital heart disease in pregnant women with a familial predisposition.

assertions.subject: VSDs
assertions.quote: Among the 65 infants born with congenital heart disease, which represented 21.5% of the total cohort, 14 were diagnosed with VSD, indicating a significant genetic component.
